actual_input: external CGEvent at AX-verified isolated status item;user explicitly authorized automatic hundred-sample acceptance
scope: warm first action to numeric AppKit bitmap/readback;not physical mouse-down or compositor/photon

input.capture_consistency: verified earlier per-file frozen JSONL copied with original mtime;databases generated privately,not new live backups

toolchain.swift:
Apple Swift version 6.3 (swiftlang-6.3.0.123.5 clang-2100.0.123.102)
Target: x86_64-apple-macosx26.0

method.order: AB/BA alternating;continuation starts AB at original even pair boundary
method.target: unique AXExtrasMenuBar item for exact verified executable;system-wide AX hit PID must match
method.pre_click: 1s receiver-ready settling;menu visibility checked,no App preactivation
method.event: mouseMoved,100ms wait,leftMouseDown,100ms wait,leftMouseUp,empty modifiers;one event pair per UUID request
method.statistics: nearest-rank percentiles;100 valid samples per arm;failed attempt retained but excluded from latency distribution
method.continuation: same input and App hashes;restore byte-identical prior SQLite seed without rescanning;temporary caffeinate bound to continuation process
method.receiver_legacy_fields: manual/operator labels belong to unchanged receiving probe;actual input is the external synthetic event journal,not human clicks
